fields.summary: OneDrive sync client stuck on Signing In with error code 0x8004de40
fields.description: User mock-marcus.vance@synthetic-test.local reported that Microsoft OneDrive client for Windows displays continuous 'Signing in' state with blue spinning icon, eventually failing with 'There was a problem signing you in. Try again in a few minutes. (Error Code: 0x8004de40)'. File Explorer sync status indicators show gray pause icons.
fields.environment: Windows 11 Enterprise 23H2, OneDrive Build 24.181.0908.0001, Device DESKTOP-ATL-9921.synthetic-test.local, IP 192.0.2.78

comments.body: Checked network connectivity to login.microsoftonline.com and oneclient.sfbassets.com. TLS 1.2 handshake was successful. Verified user account is active and licensed for SharePoint/OneDrive Plan 2 in Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

Inspected Windows Credential Manager under Control Panel > Credential Manager > Windows Credentials. Found multiple orphaned entries for 'OneDrive Cached Credential' and 'MicrosoftOffice16_Data:ADAL'. Unlinked account in OneDrive Settings > Account, but error persisted.

Performed full OneDrive client reset using command:
%localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe /reset
Waited 2 minutes, then manually relaunched OneDrive:
%localappdata%\Microsoft\OneDrive\onedrive.exe
Cleared Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin cache located at:
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\Microsoft.AAD.BrokerPlugin_cw5n1h2txyewy\AC\TokenBroker\Accounts

resolution.name: Done
resolution.description: OneDrive client reset cleared corrupt WAM token broker cache. User prompted for fresh modern auth sign-in and sync completed normally.
